name: carry_box
text: A person stands carrying a large cardboard box at waist height. Both elbows are bent and the forearms extend forward, both palms support the box underneath on opposite sides, hands shoulder width apart. The arms remain steady holding the load throughout. Small balancing weight shifts, feet remain planted, no walking.

review.notes_zh: 站立双臂在腹前承托，腕距约60厘米，左手比右手高约12厘米，对应略倾斜箱体；双手未贴合具体箱模型握点，不宣称接触已匹配。
